text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
—One! Two! One! Two! Not done yet! Keep 
elbows up! In rhythm!

One day, I participated in staff exercise 
seminar led by Tucker Brine. Though 
program supposedly designed for humans...

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text: *gasp*, *wheeze*...! T-This is brutal...!

text_block_list.name: Mid-level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Lack of regular exercise coming back to 
bite me. Still, trainers need stamina 
too...!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Exactly right!
To support racehorse girls, 
trainers need stamina too!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
By moving your own body, coaching gains 
real weight!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Now, keep going! Next, alternate knees...!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *gasp*...! No more... Can't 
breathe...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there! Don't overdo it! ...Haha, bit 
too tough?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Calculated load precisely. Should 
barely be doable even for untrained 
humans, but...?

text_block_list.name: Mid-level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but I give up. Any more will mess 
up tomorrow...

Not collapsing, nothing hurt. Still, 
feeling this exhausted felt dangerous 
later.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Makes sense. Very level-headed 
decision.
choice_data_list: (I'd like to avoid letting this in...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Rejoin once breath is caught!
Any point is 
fine! Those who can still go, let's keep 
at it!

As if relieved, trainers began crouching 
down one by one. Yet she continued moving 
energetically.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
One! Two! One! Two! Focus on biceps!
Watch 
and learn even while resting!!

Drenched in sweat, Tucker Brine continued 
intense exercise. Face bright red, 
breathing clearly labored.

text_block_list.name: Mid-level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey...! Are you okay?! You shouldn't 
push yourself too far either...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
No, don't stop me! I wanna see beyond 
limits!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Because right now! My instinct is 
screaming 'I want to beat myself'!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Nature! Environment! Always changing! So 
whatever comes at me, I take on with full 
force, holding nothing back!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Repeating that made me strong! Without 
pacing,
every challenge pushed limits 'one 
step' further!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
And then what? Before you know it, one 
step becomes two. Two steps become ten!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: You end up far beyond previous limits!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: I'll show you! Moment it's seized!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAHHHH!

Tucker Brine pushed load even higher. 
Moved by her fierce passion, found myself 
standing up before I knew it...
choice_data_list: I want to... surpass my limits too!
I want to... surpass my limits too!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: ...Ha! Alright! Let's go then!
choice_data_list: I want to... surpass it too!
I want to surpass that too!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
W-Whoa, amazing... Alright... Just one 
more step for me too...!

text_block_list.name: Mid-level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
That's right... Muscle pain builds muscle 
mass. No time to look pathetic!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Fired up now, are ya?! That's it! 
Show some guts—!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: UOOOOHHH! Burn it up!

And so, having completed the exercise, 
everyone...

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
W-We did it...! We actually made it 
through~!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Right?! You all fought damn hard!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Every single one of you surpassed your 
limits! Now,
my fine comrades!! Next up is 
the afterparty! Let's gooo!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Dahahahaha! Meat! Protein!! Nothing beats 
this after workout!

A lively BBQ began.
Thanks to unity forged 
from overcoming it together,
conversations 
flowed with energy...!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: —Hey there, Trainer! Eating well?
choice_data_list: Yes! Thank you so much for today!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! I should be the one thanking you.
choice_data_list: Yes! Thank you very much for today!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Earlier, because you took the lead and 
followed me, everyone else pushed through 
too!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
As top contributor, enjoy yourself to 
fullest! Look! Place is booming 
everywhere—

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Thick steaks over there! Fire-starting 
challenge right over here!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good! I'm still hungry too! After 
all that movement earlier, we need way 
more protein!
choice_data_list: I'll take on the fire-starting cha...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Dahahahaha! Look at that appetite! Great 
to see!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Oh right, if you love meat, I know great 
place!
Obsessed with rock salt and natural 
flavors...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Let's go together sometime!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Still aiming to train yourself?! Awesome! 
That's the spirit!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Oh, smoke! Well done! You'd survive on 
deserted island without problem!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Gotta take you along someday! You'd be 
reliable! Dahahahaha!
